# GKSolver

> > Daily current affairs and comprehensive test preparation platform for UPSC, SSC, and Banking competitive examinations with AI-powered analytics.

GKSolver provides daily news analysis, concept explanations, and practice tests for Indian competitive exam aspirants. The platform covers key topics including polity & governance, Indian economy, and current affairs with sources from The Indian Express and other major publications.

## Key Topics

- UPSC Preparation
- Current Affairs Analysis
- Competitive Exams (SSC, Banking)
- Daily News Concepts
- MCQ Practice & Test Series
- Answer Writing for Mains
- Polity & Governance
- Indian Economy
- Uniform Civil Code
- Semiconductor Industry
- Supreme Court Judgments
- Law Commission of India
- Exam Analytics & Performance Tracking
- News Analysis Methodology
- Study Material Curation

## Core Preparation Resources

- [GKSolver Homepage](https://gksolver.in): Daily current affairs covering 49+ topics for UPSC, SSC, and Banking exam preparation
- [Daily Concepts](https://gksolver.in/concepts): 149 UPSC concepts extracted from daily newspaper analysis with detailed explanations

## Test Series & Practice

- [MCQ Test Series](https://gksolver.in/test-series/mcq): Daily UPSC Prelims MCQ practice with performance analytics and answer explanations
- [Mains Answer Writing](https://gksolver.in/test-series/mains): 300+ UPSC Mains questions with AI-powered evaluation and writing improvement tracking
